title: 九上 U2 过关
note: 「语法填空」短文跨页 2–3（页3 顶部之前是它的后半）；第 4 空附近被白色修正带遮挡，短文可能存在未拍到/被遮内容，第 4、5 空答案存疑。

header.note: 本页未见班级/姓名/学号栏；页眉只有大标题「九上 U2 过关卷」

items.stem: Her smile s______ to suggest that she knew the secret.
items.note: 横线前已有印刷字母 s，学生手写补 hows，合成 shows（应为 seems）。

items.stem: My brother was so hungry that he ate a large b______ of rice just now.
items.note: 横线空白，未作答。

items.stem: Many people make serious mistakes because of their in______ of basic scientific knowledge.
items.note: 横线前印刷字母为 in（放大可辨 i+n）；横线处手写被重涂、笔画重叠，无法辨认（起笔似 mag…）。 印刷前缀被手写覆盖，in（→in ignorance of?）与 ig（→ignorance）均有可能，故不给答案。

items.stem: These traditional teaching practices are gradually d______ by the new methods.
items.note: 手写压在横线上并向右下与下一行印刷 by 重叠，形似 disappearing/disappeared，无法确认。

items.stem: The model plane is made ______ used wood and glass, and the paper is made ______ wood.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写大写 B。

items.stem: We are all busy and seem ______ less time to get together than before.
items.note: 6 题号左侧页边为 C；其下方（第 6 题选项行左端）另有一处 B 形笔迹，归属不确定。

items.stem: The owner often asks the customers ______ their suggestions.
items.note: 该题号附近页边有三处笔迹：上方一处 B；7 题号左侧一个 C 被长斜线划掉；其下一行（选项行）左端又有一个 C。综合判为改答，取 B，存疑。

items.stem: Life is ______ challenges and chances, and it is ______ something different.
items.note: 8 题号左侧页边为 B（笔迹夸张带斜划）；其上一行（第 7 题选项行）左端另有一个 C，归属不确定。

items.stem: —______ wonderful movie it is! —I couldn't agree more.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写大写 B。

items.stem: The man who ______ Ms Yang ______ giving him all her savings was finally caught.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写大写 C。

items.stem: The group members are ______ ______ the unfair decision.
items.cn: 小组成员们不满意这个不公平的决定。
items.note: 第二空手写为 satisfied，with 写在横线末端外。

items.stem: ______ it is to see these creative achievements!
items.cn: 看到这些创意成果多么令人惊讶啊！
items.note: 该题只有一处长横线，手写两个词 How amazing。

items.stem: After the meeting, he ______ ______ the coffee shop to relax.
items.cn: 会议结束后，他直接去了咖啡店放松。
items.note: 第二空手写 straight to 两词。

items.stem: He ______ in the library until the rain stopped.
items.note: 「语法」小节卷面重新从 1 编号；题号左侧手写 A，另有一条长勾从 A 行斜划下去（勾不作答案，以页边字母为准）。

items.stem: ______ will you reach the supermarket? —I'm not sure, probably in another ten minutes.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写大写 C。

items.stem: —Alice, do you go to school by bus or on foot every day? —______ It's only 5 minutes' walk.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 C；另有一条长勾从 A. Yes, I do. 斜划到选项区，勾不作答案。

items.stem: ______ you've offered! I understand this plan better now.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 B；B 选项前另有手写勾，二者不冲突。

items.stem: ______ you ______ with the new BRT system?
items.cn: 你对新的快速公交系统感到满意吗？
items.note: 两空手写 Are / satisfied。

items.stem: ______ the heat, or the milk will ______.
items.cn: 把火调小，不然牛奶会溢出来。
items.note: 两空各手写两个词。

items.stem: —______ you ______ to Disneyland? —Yes, I ______ ______ twice before.
items.cn: ——你去过迪士尼乐园吗？——是的，之前我去过那两次了。
items.note: 四个空依次为 Have / been / have / been to。

items.stem: Please ______ the box and put it on the table.
items.cn: 请把箱子抬起来，放到桌子上。
items.note: 一空手写两个词 pick up。

items.stem: ______ a ______ experience it is!
items.cn: （2024 广州）这是一次多么有意义的经历啊！
items.note: 第一空手写 what；第二空手写被反复涂画成一团黑，无法辨认。

items.stem: ______ you ever ______ about a maths project done by some students in Guangzhou?
items.cn: （2023 广州）你听说过一群广州学生做的数学项目吗？
items.note: 两空手写 Have / heard。

items.stem: People were ______(doubt) whether this was a safe or accurate way.
items.note: 页顶为短文语法填空（属本卷上一页末段，原文前半未拍到），此为其第1空；手写 doubtful。本页该部分题号与「阅读」1-6 重复，故连续编号为 18

items.stem: Doctors needed a tool ______(check) fevers, and scientists needed one to study heat.
items.note: 同上一题短文第2空；手写潦草，疑为 to check

items.stem: A better way to measure temperature ______(need).
items.note: 短文第3空；手写字迹潦草（形似 in need / is needed），无法确认

items.stem: The thermometer helps us ______ many ways.
items.note: 短文第4空；该空（含可能的括号提示）被白色涂改带整块遮挡，仅见左右两侧 helps us 与 many ways，故题干只保留空格

items.stem: Cooks use it for baking, ______. Factories use it to keep machines safe.
items.note: 短文第5空；空及提示被白色涂改带遮挡（涂改带上有手写字迹，形似 Mony），无法确认；右侧 Factories 的 Fa 亦被覆盖

items.stem: It ______(apply) to many aspects of our daily lives, bringing great convenience.
items.note: 短文第6空；该空未见手写作答

passages.语法填空: For thousands of years, people could not measure temperature exactly. They only knew if something was hot or cold by touching it. People were {{1}}(doubt) whether this was a safe or accurate way. Doctors needed a tool {{2}}(check) fevers, and scientists needed one to study heat. A better way to measure temperature {{3}}(need). The thermometer helps us {{4}} many ways. Cooks use it for baking, {{5}}. Factories use it to keep machines safe. It {{6}}(apply) to many aspects of our daily lives, bringing great convenience.
